lines.zh: 我一步一步踏过地牢石砖。
lines.en: I tread the dungeon flagstones, step by step.

lines.zh: 我的脚步声在长廊里回响。
lines.en: My steps echo down the corridor.
My shoulder scrapes the soot off the arch.
Bones rattle inside me.

lines.zh: 我的影子把整条走廊堵住。
lines.en: My shadow fills the corridor.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，火把都暗一下。
lines.en: Each step dims the torches.
I pass under the arch.
There is no reason for haste.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转身，头骨对着你。
lines.en: I turn slowly, my skull facing you.

lines.zh: 石砖被我的重量压出细纹。
lines.en: The flagstones crack under my weight.
I stand there without moving.

lines.zh: 我的骨头里没有一点热。
lines.en: There is no warmth in my bones at all.

lines.zh: 我在数这条长廊有几盏灯。
lines.en: I count the lamps in this corridor.
There is no wind in the dungeon.
My joints click now and then.

lines.zh: 这副骨架从不需要呼吸。
lines.en: This frame has never needed breath.
My armor is harder than stone.
I wait for someone to trespass.
A lamp goes out; I do not care.
The angle of my head has not changed.

lines.zh: 这具身体是九千九百九十九。
lines.en: This body stands at nine thousand nine hundred ninety-nine.

lines.zh: 我的头骨转了半圈，对准门。
lines.en: My skull turns half around to face the door.
Water drips beneath the floor.

lines.zh: 我的指骨在石台上敲了两下。
lines.en: My finger bones tap twice on the stone ledge.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有门被推开。
lines.en: I hear a door opened somewhere far.
I wait, with great patience.
You have come to the wrong place.
These doors do not open for the living.
The light about you is harsh.

lines.zh: 我一直在等你这一类人。
lines.en: I have been waiting for your kind.

lines.zh: 你手里那件召唤物，我认得。
lines.en: I know that summon in your hand.

lines.zh: 你不用回头，后面也是墙。
lines.en: No need to look back; there is a wall.

lines.zh: 你走进来的时候，就已经输了。
lines.en: You lost the moment you walked in.
You cannot guess my numbers.

lines.zh: 你数过自己还剩多少心跳吗。
lines.en: Have you counted your remaining heartbeats?
I am older than this dungeon.

lines.zh: 你的武器在我身上会崩。
lines.en: Your weapon will break on me.
Halt; no further.

lines.zh: 你打在我甲上，只掉了点灰。
lines.en: You struck my armor and only dust fell.
That is not a wound.
That much force only raises dust.
Your hand must be numb.

lines.zh: 我垂眼看了看甲上的印。
lines.en: I glance down at the mark on my armor.
The dungeon's stones are more brittle than I.

lines.zh: 九千九百九十九的护甲，你懂吗。
lines.en: Nine thousand nine hundred ninety-nine armor; do you understand?
You struck well; it was simply not enough.

lines.zh: 我的甲缝里连刀痕都留不下。
lines.en: Not even a blade mark stays in my seams.
Then strike this shell again.

lines.zh: 这里没有你要找的东西。
lines.en: There is nothing here you seek.
Those gems are bait.
I do not even need to look.

lines.zh: 你手里那点光，我瞧不上。
lines.en: That little light in your hand means nothing to me.

lines.zh: 这地牢里的一切都是我的。
lines.en: Everything in this dungeon is mine.

lines.zh: 你举着它，像举着一根蜡烛。
lines.en: You hold it up like a candle.

lines.zh: 这些金子留在地牢里吧。
lines.en: Leave the gold here in the dungeon.

lines.zh: 再往前一步，这东西就归我了。
lines.en: One more step and it is mine.
I shake my head slowly.
Leave, while you still can.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，像撞地牢的墙。
lines.en: You hit me like the dungeon's wall.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我连脚都没动。
lines.en: You slam into me and I do not even shift a foot.
Something in you cracked.

lines.zh: 这一下反弹把你推回去了。
lines.en: The rebound pushed you back.

lines.zh: 我的护甲上连个印都没有。
lines.en: There is not even a mark on my armor.
You are against my leg; very dangerous.
We collided and the corridor shook.
Step back; this time I do not follow.

lines.zh: 你那一身轻甲，挡不住我。
lines.en: That light armor of yours will not stop me.
This far and no further.
This body does not belong to the living.
The dungeon needs no offspring.

lines.zh: 我连名字都只是一个称呼。
lines.en: Even my name is only a title.
Your question is very light.
I lower my head and my bones click.
Only death is kept here.

lines.zh: 我不回答，也不需要回答。
lines.en: I do not answer, nor need to.

lines.zh: 这具骨架不配有后来者。
lines.en: This frame is not meant to have offspring.

lines.zh: 这个话题在墓里更合适。
lines.en: That subject belongs in a tomb.
Go; do not stay.
I bend and my joints creak.

lines.zh: 这东西在你眼里很贵重。
lines.en: This thing is precious in your eyes.
I squeeze once and it shatters.
I drop it back on the flagstones.

lines.zh: 我两根指骨就夹住了它。
lines.en: Two of my finger bones pinch it still.
I raise it and glance at it.
I have no need of keys.
The light on it is faint.
I tuck it between my ribs.
Without it you cannot leave.
You have entered the deep dungeon.
The dungeon has your position.

lines.zh: 地砖把我的重量传给了你。
lines.en: The flagstones pass my weight along to you.

lines.zh: 从这一步开始，你不再有选择。
lines.en: From this step, you have no choices.
I start walking from the far end of the corridor.
The other end of the corridor is me.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把开始发抖。
lines.en: The torch in your hand begins to shake.

lines.zh: 我抬起一只石一样的手。
lines.en: I raise a hand like stone.
The corridor behind you is a dead end.

lines.zh: 九千九百九十九，你打不动。
lines.en: Nine thousand nine hundred ninety-nine; you cannot.
Listen; the floor is resonating.

lines.zh: 这一步我踏下去，地牢就响。
lines.en: When I take this step, the dungeon resounds.

lines.zh: 你往哪边跑，我都知道路。
lines.en: Whichever way you run, I know the path.
I have waited far too long.

lines.zh: 我一步迈出去，火把灭了。
lines.en: I take a step and the torches die.

lines.zh: 入口的碎石已经堵死了。
lines.en: Rubble has already choked the entrance.
Do not shout; no one is here.
You chose a dead end.

lines.zh: 我把两只手都举起来了。
lines.en: I have raised both hands.

lines.zh: 你再往前，就是我的走廊。
lines.en: One step further, and you are in my corridor.
I press down the corridor.
You run into a side room; it is narrower.

lines.zh: 我的脚步比你慢，却不会停。
lines.en: My steps are slower, but never stopping.

lines.zh: 墙上的火把随着我熄灭。
lines.en: The torches die as I pass.
I hear you panting behind the door.
I knock the doorframe down.
You retreat into the innermost room.
Those bricks are old and will fall.
I am behind you, unhurried.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，地砖就裂一条。
lines.en: Each step splits a flagstone.
I hear your blood running.
This corridor has no branches.
I stand at the corridor mouth.

lines.zh: 这条走廊的尽头没有门。
lines.en: There is no door at the end of this corridor.
I lay a hand on the wall.
Grit falls.
Ten more steps and it ends.
At the corridor's end you have stopped.
I level my empty eye sockets at you.
Now, look this way.

lines.zh: 我一掌拍下去，地砖碎成粉。
lines.en: I bring my palm down and flagstones powder.
There is nothing fancy in it.
You are driven into the wall.
This fist punches a pit in the stone wall.
You strike me and only chip your blade.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的肩，慢慢收紧。
lines.en: I take your shoulder and squeeze slowly.

lines.zh: 我听见你肋骨断了一根。
lines.en: I hear one of your ribs give way.
You cannot break my grip.

lines.zh: 我掐住你的腰，把你抬离地面。
lines.en: I grip your waist and lift you off the floor.
Then I set you down, lightly.
You lie on the floor, still moving.

lines.zh: 我踩下去，石砖凹了一块。
lines.en: I stamp down and a flagstone dents.
This will finish it.
You still have one breath.
I wake in the deepest part of the dungeon.

lines.zh: 火把在我周围同时亮起。
lines.en: The torches light at once around me.

lines.zh: 这具身体由召唤物带来。
lines.en: This body is brought by a summon.

lines.zh: 九千九百九十九，从第一刻起。
lines.en: Nine thousand nine hundred ninety-nine, from the first moment.
My joints align one by one.
Water seeps between the dungeon's bricks.
I raise my head and light fills my sockets.
I have waited long for this step.

lines.zh: 走廊另一头有人在呼吸。
lines.en: Someone is breathing at the other end.
I turn my head that way.
The floor begins to tremble.
Good; a guest has come.
I raise one hand to my chest.
Firelight slides over my armor.

lines.zh: 我数着这一层有几块砖。
lines.en: I count the bricks on this floor.
You took the wrong turn.

lines.zh: 这一段路我闭着眼也走。
lines.en: I could walk this stretch blind.

lines.zh: 长廊尽头的灯一盏盏亮了。
lines.en: The lamps at the corridor's end light one by one.

lines.zh: 我把一只手按在石棺上。
lines.en: I rest one hand on the stone coffin.
The dungeon's door has already shut.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的甲，没有一点痕迹。
lines.en: Fire sweeps my armor and leaves no mark.

lines.zh: 我落地，把地砖砸出一个洞。
lines.en: I land and punch a hole in the floor.

lines.zh: 水漫进来，我的骨头在响。
lines.en: Water rises and my bones creak.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的披风掀起来。
lines.en: The blast lifts my cloak.

lines.zh: 箭射在我甲上，碎成几段。
lines.en: The arrow shatters on my armor.

lines.zh: 那点术法连甲缝都进不去。
lines.en: That magic cannot even reach my seams.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，只是越来越沉闷。
lines.en: I do not eat; I only grow more silent.
Lightning runs along my armor.

lines.zh: 我坠下去，骨头在风里响。
lines.en: I fall, my bones sounding in the wind.
